note: Answer each question true/false (the design-analysis applicability questionnaire). Lens selection is then a deterministic function of these answers + the sibling applicability-map.json.

questions.prompt: Does the feature have a user-facing UI?
Does it handle auth, secrets, PII, or compliance?
Does it read or write persistent data (database, files, durable state)?
Does it integrate with external services or APIs?
Does it change deployment, CI/CD, or release?
Does it have performance/scale or resilience concerns?

answers_provenance: Mirrors the feature-level lens selection the human confirmed at the design workshop (specs/001-ring-mcp-bridge/lens-applicability.json: all ten technical lenses selected and closed, human-confirmed, lens-question scope). Not a new confirmation.
